ticket.subject: Data processing agreement request
ticket.body_text:
Dear support,

I'm the IT lead at Brambleway Studio. Before our renewal, we need your DPA and details on where our data is stored and which sub-processors you use.

Our renewal is in three weeks. We are an EU company, so the transfer terms matter to us.

Could you look into this sometime this week? Please send the documents or a link.

Kind regards,
Mateo Moreau
IT lead, Brambleway Studio
